---
title: "Central Park Weather Dashboard - 2009"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
```


```{r data_preparation, include=FALSE}
data("ny_noaa")

ny_noaa_df =
  ny_noaa %>%
  filter(id == "USW00094728") %>%
  separate(
    date,
    into = c("year", "month", "day"),
    sep = "-",
    convert = TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(year == 2009) %>%
  mutate(
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = as.numeric(prcp) / 10,
    month = factor(
      month,
      levels = 1:12,
      labels = month.abb
    )
  ) %>%
  select(year, month, day, tmax, tmin, prcp)
ny_noaa_df
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily Minimum vs Maximum Temperature

```{r}
ny_noaa_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(tmin),
    !is.na(tmax)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c(
      "Date: ", month, " ", day, ", ", year,
      "\nTmin: ", tmin, " C",
      "\nTmax: ", tmax, " C"
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(
    `Minimum temperature (C)` = tmin,
    `Maximum temperature (C)` = tmax
  ) %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~`Minimum temperature (C)`,
    y = ~`Maximum temperature (C)`,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    color = ~month,
    text = ~text_label,
    alpha = 0.5
  )

```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Monthly Maximum Temperature Distribution

```{r}
ny_noaa_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(tmax)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Month = month,
    `Daily maximum temperature (C)` = tmax
  ) %>%
  plot_ly(
    y = ~`Daily maximum temperature (C)`,
    color = ~Month,
    type = "box",
    colors = "viridis"
  )

```

### Monthly Days with Precipitation

```{r}
ny_noaa_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(prcp),
    prcp > 0
  ) %>%
  count(month) %>%
  rename(
    Month = month,
    `Days with precipitation` = n
  ) %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~Month,
    y = ~`Days with precipitation`,
    type = "bar",
    color = ~Month,
    colors = "viridis"
  )

```
